summary: The diff adds an Add Vehicle page and routing/nav links, plus a backend addVehicle method with auto-increment IDs. However, the backend method signature/return type does not match REQ-7 (returns Nat instead of Vehicle), and some frontend AC items (success UX, post-create navigation, query invalidation) cannot be fully verified due to truncation. The diff also introduces unrequested backend migration and ID-type refactors.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend create/update method returns the created Vehicle (including its assigned unique id), not just an id.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo implements addVehicle(...) : async Nat and returns only the generated id, whereas REQ-7 requires returning the created Vehicle object (including id).

missing_requirements.requirement: After successful creation, the user can navigate to the created vehicle’s detail page or see it appear in the relevant category listing after refresh/query invalidation.
missing_requirements.reason: AddVehiclePage.tsx is truncated before the post-submit success handling; the diff summary does not provide direct evidence of navigation to the created vehicle detail page (e.g., navigate('/vehicle/$id', ...)) or showing it in-category beyond claims in a separate summary file.

missing_requirements.requirement: Submitting the form successfully creates a vehicle in the backend and shows a clear success message in English.
missing_requirements.reason: The form submission logic is truncated at the actor.addVehicle(...) call site; the diff does not show the success toast/message content or that it is displayed on success.

missing_requirements.requirement: Seed sample vehicles button inserts at least 1 vehicle per category (Bike, Motorcycle, Car) using the same backend add/create method as the form.
missing_requirements.reason: The AddVehiclePage implementation is truncated and does not show the seeding handler or the specific seeded vehicles/categories; the only mention is in a high-level summary text file, which is not sufficient to verify AC details.

missing_requirements.requirement: After a successful add/seed, React Query vehicle list queries are invalidated/refetched so Home/Category pages reflect changes.
missing_requirements.reason: Although useQueryClient is imported, the diff is truncated before any invalidateQueries/refetch logic is shown; the only assertion is in a summary text file.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend migration module and refactor changing vehicle/favorites IDs from Int to Nat, with migration logic and nextId state.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest did not request schema migration or an ID-type refactor (Int->Nat) nor adding a migration module; it only requested an add/create method with auto-assigned unique IDs.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer ‘Connect’ social links/icons and a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM tracking changes.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-7/8/9/10; these are unrelated UI/content additions beyond adding an Add Vehicle workflow.
